title: Draw Me a Star
author: Eric Carle
current_text: Draw Me a Star was banned in at least four school districts since 2021, including districts in Florida, Iowa, and Texas. In 1996, a parent challenged Draw Me a Star in a Seattle suburb, calling it “soft pornography” that might encourage children to draw naked bodies. In 1999, Draw Me a Star was challenged but retained in the Dorothy B. Bunce Elementary School library in Pavilion, N.Y., despite a parent’s objection to a collage picture of a naked man and woman representing Adam and Eve.

sources.quote: Alas for children in school districts in Florida, Iowa, and Texas, the couple is also naked. The book has been banned in at least four school districts since 2021, and other schools have covered the handsome couple in paper clothes.

sources.quote: Draw Me a Star was challenged several times in Carle’s lifetime, including in 1996 in a Seattle suburb where a parent called it “soft pornography” that might encourage children to draw naked bodies themselves.
